steps.speaker: Four-leaf Clover People
steps.content: Roulecca... Roulecca...

The four-leaf clovers around her wither away one by one. Their bodies thin out and finally disappear. Just like the "father" said, once the truth is known, these fake family members can no longer make her happy.
The child is at a loss. No longer happy and carefree, she shuts her eyes tightly, unwilling to see what is happening around her, while at the same time enduring the overwhelming pain of old memories.
You don't say anything. You just pick up the volleyball in silence, pat it twice, and serve it over the net. Then you flip the scoreboard and walk over to Roulecca.
The girl is kneeling on the rose-gold beach. The fine grains of sand are flowing to the edge of the world and disappearing into nothingness.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: You villain, you devil, you big bad brute... You're just like those evil gangsters. You took everything Roulecca had...

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: I won't forgive you! I'll have my revenge... Just you wait, one day...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Grant me my wish before that then. Lose graciously.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Your wish already came true. You took away my family for the second time...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's not my wish. I was just tricking you. My real wish is...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Bid farewell to your daddy, Roulecca.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: ...Huh?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: He loves you very much.
You take a step back, giving way to the four-leaf clover man behind you. You leave the last moments of the dream to this father and daughter.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: You realized another wish on your bucket list. We found the most beautiful beach and played volleyball together.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Did you have fun, Roulecca?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: ...Why are you on his side?

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Daddy is always on Roulecca's side.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Then why do you want Roulecca to wake up?!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: You know I'd be heartbroken! You know I just want to stay and be with all of you! Yet you...

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Damn it! It's just Ambrosia, isn't it... I'll find Mess! She has a lot of it! She'll give it to me. I'll be back. I'll be back no matter how many times it takes!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Next time, I'll create my real daddy! A daddy who will never betray Roulecca! I won't let you guys crush my dreams again!!

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: It'll be the same, Roulecca. Ambrosia will never change "my" resolve.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: As long as you still miss your real father, the "father" you create will try to wake you up every time, no matter what it takes.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: You're lying! My real daddy wouldn't push me away! My real daddy wouldn't make me cry!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: You're a fake! You're just a four-leaf clover! You're not my real daddy...

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: You're right. I'm just a hallucination... But I know his heart better than anyone else.
He lifts up the girl's tear-streaked face.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Your real father would never allow anyone to toy with your feelings. He would break Ambrosia's curse and take you back every time.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Wake up, Roulecca... Wake up, and grow up. You two made so many wishes that belong to the future. He wants you to see the world, and to meet more people who love you and are worthy of your love.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: The past cannot be changed, but both he and the four-leaf clovers are always watching over you. You're the luckiest little girl now, Roulecca, and in the future, you'll be the happiest too.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Your father's greatest wish has always been for you to grow up happy. You know that better than anyone else, don't you, Roulecca?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: ...Sob... No, that's not right... No!
She strikes his chest over and over again with fists weakened by crying.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: My real daddy wouldn't leave me all alone! He wants to see me grow up and find happiness with his own eyes! That's what he wants, right? Right?!

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: ...Yes, he wants that.
The man leans down and hugs the sobbing girl tightly. Time is running out. As the funny-looking four-leaf clover fades away, the last thing you see is a father's tearful face.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: I'm sorry, Roulecca... I'm not your real father...

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: I'm sorry... for not being able to watch you grow up...

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: ...Sob... You liar... Let go... You're not my daddy, you...

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: ...Ahhh!

The embrace supporting her suddenly shatters. The man dissolves into countless four-leaf clovers that scatter into the air. The girl tries to grab them in panic, but the leaves slip through her fingers, and she ends up with nothing.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: No... No!!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Don't go! Don't leave me! Come back, I beg you!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Daddy!!!

The dream has been broken, but you can't bear to watch the final ending. You never did find out what happened on the birthday that Roulecca got her revolver and lucky power, or what exactly she is so desperate to forget.
You start to float as the ground slips away beneath your feet. Your consciousness gradually drifts away to the sound of the girl's whimpers.
Before completely merging into the darkness, you hear a voice.

steps.speaker: Male Voice
steps.content: Thank you...
